clues.text: A town on a plain in Turkey is ringed by tall mountains. High peaks stand to its north, west, and south.
clues.narrowing: rules out everything outside the mountain-ringed plains of Turkey

source.quote: Hınıs district is surrounded by the Ak Dağ mountains from the north, Bingöl Mountains from the west and south, and Akdoğan mountains from the south to the east.

clues.text: Winters here are cold and snowy, while summers are mostly cool. Yet this place stays five to six degrees warmer than Erzurum.
clues.narrowing: narrows to cold-winter, cool-summer towns that run warmer than Erzurum itself

source.quote: It has the same characteristics as Erzurum in terms of climate and nature. Winters are cold and snowy, and summers are generally cool. In general, it can be said that it is 5-6 degrees warmer than Erzurum.

clues.text: Its Ulu Cami Mosque was built in 1734 by Alaeddin, the bey of Muş. An old castle also stands in the town today.

source.quote: Historical monuments in the town include the castle and the Ulu Cami Mosque, said to be built in 1734 by Alaeddin, the bey of Muş.

clues.text: Its flat land is one of the most fertile plains in the region. Farms and herds, not shops or factories, earn most people their living.
clues.narrowing: narrows to farming towns on one of the most fertile plains in the region

source.quote: Hınıs is a plain district and Hınıs Plain is one of the most fertile plains of the region. Therefore, agriculture and animal husbandry are the main sources of income in the district.

clues.text: This town sits close to Hamurpert Lake. That lake holds a big place in local history.

source.quote: The district, which is 150 km away from the city of Muş, is very close to Hamurpert Lake, which has an important place in history.
